Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. (2026-09-22). CDSCO classification · Application and licence trail. Pinnacle Verification Centre evidence summary. https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/classification.html

original The issued MD-5 identifies the device as Class B. Company publications describe a preceding Central Licensing Authority classification decision. The locally available risk-classification form is an application proposing Class A, not the approved Class B decision. A classification decision is also distinct from a manufacturing licence. Original source: Risk-classification application, p1; Evidence Dossier v2, pp23–24; September handout, physical pp1 and 9; operative MD-5, p1.
